name: screen-share
description: /screen-share hides emails, phone numbers, money amounts, names, keys and card numbers on screen while you record. Only the drawing changes: Claude and the chat still hold the real data. If hiding a row fails, the row is drawn as a bar, never as raw text.

style.title: How hidden text looks
style.description: bar: shaded bars as long as the text. partial: a hint like j***@d***.com. label: a tag like [email].

bar_glyph.title: Bar character
bar_glyph.description: The character a bar is drawn with. Used by the bar style.

names.title: Names
names.description: off: never hide names. context: only where the text says it is a person (a From: line, Name <email>, Hi Jane). smart: also two words that look like a first and last name.

always_mask.title: Always hide these words
always_mask.description: Names, clients, project code names. Separate with commas. Matches any case, and acme corp also finds acme-corp. Words added with /screen-share add are kept in ~/.claude/claude-mods/screen-share.json and join this list.

never_mask.title: Never hide these words
never_mask.description: Words the automatic rules must leave alone, separated by commas. Start an entry with @ to allow a whole email domain (@mycompany.com). Words on the always-hide list still win.

mask_amounts.title: Hide money amounts
mask_amounts.description: Amounts with a currency sign, code or word, and plain numbers after words like total or price.

mask_names.title: Hide names
mask_names.description: See Names for how names are found.

mask_secrets.title: Hide keys and tokens
mask_secrets.description: API keys, tokens, passwords after a key name, private keys.

mask_numbers.title: Hide card and ID numbers
mask_numbers.description: Card numbers that pass their checksum, IBANs, SSN-style IDs.

mask_paths.title: Hide your user name in folder paths

mask_addresses.title: Hide street addresses
mask_addresses.description: Street lines, UK postcodes and US city, state ZIP lines, and fields named address or zip.

mask_username.title: Hide this computer's user name everywhere
mask_username.description: Your account name (from your home folder) is hidden wherever it appears, not only in paths. Ordinary words like test or admin are never used.

mask_panels.title: Also hide in other mods' panels and bands
mask_panels.description: Walks the text of other mods' panes and the band above the prompt. Their layout is left alone.

hide_suggestions.title: Hide the prompt box suggestion
hide_suggestions.description: The dim suggestion in the prompt box is made from the chat and Tab writes it into the box, so it is hidden while screen share is on.

peek_seconds.title: Peek length (seconds)
peek_seconds.description: How long Peek shows the real text before hiding it again. 1 to 120.

fade_in.title: Fade bars in
fade_in.description: Draw the bars light for a moment when screen share turns on.
